# Valley News

> Valley News is a regional job board and employment platform serving the Upper Valley area of Vermont and New Hampshire with job listings, career guidance, and professional development resources.

Valley News connects job seekers with employers across the Upper Valley region, including communities like Hanover, Lebanon, White River Junction, and Essex Junction. The platform provides comprehensive employment resources tailored to local and regional opportunities.

## Key Topics

- job listings
- job board
- career advice
- resume tips
- local jobs
- regional employment
- professional development
- workplace guidance
- Upper Valley
- Hanover NH
- Lebanon NH
- White River Junction VT

## Job Board & Listings

- [Valley News | Find Your Next Job With Valley News](https://jobs.vnews.com/): Valley News job board with 2M+ listings, resume tools, and career guidance
